description: Check one job: status (running, completed or failed), package, price, payment record and webhook delivery. Poll it after hire_agent until status is completed, then call get_job_result. Only for jobs of your key's account. The same as GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}.

api_key.description: Your Roster API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.
